ops.title: Stop CCI rebuilding freshly built read models
ops.description: Owner: current host-tooling coordinator. Natural CPU profile at ~/.vcache/scratch/cost-retro-20261102/cci-daemon-natural-cpu.pprof attributes 86% of daemon CPU to read-model construction. Build calls withinCap while builtBytes is zero, permanently setting full before baseline initialization. Next: reset refill state when baseline is established, add regression covering initial fullness and real appended growth, ship and install, then profile normal traffic.

ops.text: Initial construction does not request an immediate refill; appended growth still requests refill
Fix merged, released and installed in the local daemon
Natural post-install profile no longer shows repeated read-model rebuilding
